text:
maya: quick async check — onboarding zeta-65b v2. HF URI is https://huggingface.co/redwood/zeta-65b/tree/v2 but our registry mirror (s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta-65b/v2/) doesn't contain the final checkpoint file. can someone confirm origin ACLs and the published checksum?
sam: pinging infra — i'll grep mirror logs and presign attempts, will report back.
infra-bot: mirror-job/2026-02-18-13:02 started for huggingface/redwood/zeta-65b v2 -> s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta-65b/v2/ (job id: mj-8842).
jg: heads-up — tokenizer for zeta-65b has a byte-level vs bpe mismatch history. if weights moved between releases we should validate tokenizer.json charset and merges. i can run a quick tokenization smoke.
eli: can you paste exact missing filename? usually it's `pytorch_model.bin` or `sharded-00001-of-00004.bin` depending on HF layout. also need the expected sha256 from the model card.
maya: missing file listed in HF index: `shard-00004-of-00004.safetensors`. model card checksum field says `sha256: 3a9f2b...d1c4` (truncated). registry shows only shards 1-3.
sam: logs show presign failed with 403 on 2026-02-18T13:04:22 for shard-00004... looks like origin returned AccessDenied on GET. suspect HF token used by mirror agent expired. i'm restarting the mirror job with a fresh token.
infra-bot: mirror-job/2026-02-18-13:07 restarted (mj-8842-r1).
jg: while shard is missing, tokenizer smoke: ran `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); print(t.encode('Hello, world'))"` and got an unexpected split on emojis — indicates tokenizers v0.12 vs v0.13 differences. we should pin tokenizer version in the manifest.
eli: +1 on pinning. for checksum verification i ran locally: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta-65b/v2/shard-00004-of-00004.safetensors ./ && sha256sum shard-00004-of-00004.safetensors` -> expecting `3a9f2b...d1c4`. once mirror job writes it we can auto-verify in registry ingest.
maya: action items: (1) sam confirm mirror job completes and upload succeeds, (2) infra add tokenizer runtime pin to model manifest (tokenizers>=0.12,<0.14), (3) eli please add checksum field to registry metadata and fail ingest on mismatch — can you do that?
sam: updating job now, will post final status here.
infra-bot: mirror-job/2026-02-18-13:12 completed for shard-00004-of-00004.safetensors (size 3.1G). presign TTL used: 15m.
sam: verified `sha256=3a9f2b5e9a...d1c4` matches model card. uploaded and registry manifest updated.
jg: pushed a small PR to the model-manifests repo to add `tokenizers` runtime hint and a note about BPE variant. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-manifests/pull/412
eli: added checksum validation rule to registry ingest lambda (deployed to staging). will schedule a quick run to backfill recent ingests.
maya: excellent — thanks all. leaving this thread open for any fallout but closing parent task in linear. if anyone sees tokenization mismatches in evals, ping here. :rocket:
